validation_protocol.effect_training: one season-centered residual map per earlier evaluated OOF season; missing IDs contribute zero before equal source-season averaging
validation_protocol.stable_variant: at least two matched source seasons and unanimous nonzero effect sign, checked separately for pitcher and batter
validation_protocol.pair_variants: all-prior source-season-centered pitcher_id x batter_id effect, smoothing 2000, unseen pair zero; evaluated only as pair-only and player50:50 plus pair weight 0.25

selection.status: diagnostic only; candidate comparison is non-nested
